# Rear Hatch Strut Replacement

> **[Unverified]** This page rests on a single community report. Cross-check before relying on it.

## Summary

Supporting the rear hatch with a tall ladder, this job replaces both existing struts simultaneously to restore proper lift and support. [t9]

## Tools

- Tall ladder [t9]
- Vice grips or vice [t9]
- Pliers [t9]

## Parts

- Ball Socket, Part #9416K79: M8 thread, x2 [t9]

## Tips & gotchas

- Reuse the original retaining clip and socket from the old struts where possible. [t9]
- Use a little Loctite when putting ball sockets on to prevent them loosening. [t9]

## Common mistakes

- Forgetting that both sides must be removed at once for better hatch clearance. [t9]
